name: Ovation Hollywood
description: Ovation Hollywood is a premier shopping, dining, and entertainment destination located in the heart of Hollywood, just steps from the iconic Hollywood Walk of Fame. Formerly known as Hollywood & Highland Center, this vibrant complex offers visitors an immersive experience with favorite retail shops, diverse restaurants, a movie theater, bowling, and experiential entertainment. Whether grabbing a quick bite or enjoying a full day out, Ovation Hollywood delivers the quintessential Hollywood experience for locals and tourists alike.
